attchmntText: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited published newspaper advertisements for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The consolidated net profit after tax was 109,248.33 lakhs for the three months and 112,635.65 lakhs for the six months ended September 30, 2026. Earnings per share were 112.33 basic and 112.27 diluted for the quarter. Shriram Properties Limited approved its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the same period on November 13, 2026. The standalone net profit after tax was 2,375.18 lakhs for the quarter and 3,907.83 lakhs for the half-year. Earnings per share were 17.71 basic and 17.71 diluted for the quarter. Switching Technologies Limited announced a special window for re-lodgement of physical share transfer deeds from February 5, 2026, to February 4, 2027. Bhartiya International Limited approved its un-audited financial results on November 12, 2026. A public caution notice was issued regarding a lost will deed by Mr. A. V. Ramakrishnan.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by India Ratings & Research Private Limited. The report highlights a deviation in the utilization of proceeds from a preferential issue. While the company received INR 10 Crores from warrant subscriptions, it utilized INR 4 Crores for General Corporate Purposes. This expenditure exceeds the permissible 25% limit of the received proceeds by INR 1.50 Crores. The deviation occurred because 6,23,054 warrants lapsed, reducing the total proceeds received. The Board has recommended a Special Resolution by Postal Ballot to vary the objects to include debt repayment and operating expenses, extend the timeline to March 31, 2027, and ratify the excess utilization of INR 1.50 Crores. The resolution is pending shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the earnings call for the quarter and half ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 13, 2026. The recording covers un-audited financial results on both standalone and consolidated bases. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30, read with Part A of Schedule III and 46(2) (oa) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The audio file is available on the company website under the link titled Q2 FY2027-Earnings call recording. The notice was issued by S. Balasundharam, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations rose 17% year-on-year to Rs. 51 Cr for Q2FY27, with half-year revenue up 34% to Rs. 104 Cr. EBITDA increased 28% to Rs. 12.7 Cr in Q2FY27. Profit after tax turned positive at Rs. 13.4 Cr in Q2FY27, compared to a loss of Rs. 12.8 Cr in the prior year period. The company announced that the NCLT sanctioned the demerger of its Commerce business, J.K. Shah Commerce Education Limited, on August 20, 2026, effective August 31, 2026. In-principle listing approvals for J.K. Shah Commerce Education Limited have been received from NSE, BSE, and SEBI. Shareholders as on October 6, 2026, will receive one J.K. Shah share for every Veranda share held.

attchmntText: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited filed an earnings presentation for the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half ended September 30, 2026. Revenue grew 17% year on year to INR 51 Cr. Reported EBITDA rose 28% to INR 12.7 Cr. Profit after tax stood at INR 13.4 Cr, compared with a loss in the prior year period. The company reported that the NCLT sanctioned the Commerce demerger on August 20, 2026, effective August 31, 2026. In-principle approvals were received from NSE, BSE, and SEBI for the listing of J.K. Shah Commerce Education Limited. The record date for the demerger was October 6, 2026.

attchmntText: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited approved its unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Statutory auditors M/s Suresh Surana & Associates LLP issued an unmodified review report on the financial results. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 5,059.28 lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 10,408.36 lakhs. The company reported a profit after tax from continuing operations of Rs. 1,342.81 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 12,051.69 lakhs for the half year. Exceptional items included Rs. 13,337.86 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 13,337.86 lakhs for the half year. The results are available on the company website.
